summary: Backend e2e tested via pytest (33 tests). Fixed listing _id leak bug (returned 500). 32/33 passed. Frontend smoke tests: landing, browse, login, register pages render. Admin login blocked at test time due to brute-force lockout from earlier diagnostic curl.

critical.issue: Returned 500 — MongoDB _id leaked into response after insert_one (FIXED by adding doc.pop('_id'))

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout uses request.client.host which behind k8s ingress can be the proxy IP — works for same IP but unreliable. After 1 lockout (429), subsequent attempts returned 401 (suggests IP rotation or rec reset). Consider using X-Forwarded-For + per-email-only counters.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is rejected by browsers per CORS spec. Currently works because frontend is same-origin via ingress, but explicit origins should be configured.
CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router(); should be added before for clarity (functionally still works).
No transaction/atomic check between balance debit and listing status update — race-prone under concurrent purchases.

integration_issues.issue: /api/auth/me fires on every page returning 401 for guests — produces console errors. Should suppress 401 logs for unauthenticated probe.

action_items: Review brute-force lockout reliability behind proxy (use X-Forwarded-For or email-only key)
Set explicit CORS_ORIGINS instead of '*' with credentials
Consider order purchase atomicity to prevent double-spend
Frontend: handle 401 silently from /api/auth/me on initial unauthenticated load
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~676 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth/listings/orders/admin) before it grows further
Multiple endpoints insert_one then return mutated doc — pattern is fragile; standardize via a serializer or always pop _id
encrypt/decrypt uses json.dumps stringify in-route; extract to helper
No rate limiting on listing creation or order endpoints
test_credentials: Admin: admin@lootra.com / Admin@12345 (test created users on the fly)
seed_data_creation: Created per-run unique seller/buyer/listings under TEST_-style suffixes; not cleaned up — safe as unique UUID-prefixed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend critical bug (listing _id leak causing 500) fixed by testing agent. Remaining minor issues are design-level. Full purchase-reveal-confirm-release flow works end-to-end via API. Frontend admin/buyer purchase UI flow not yet validated in browser due to lockout state during test; main agent can self-test or rerun after waiting 15 min for lockout to expire.
rca of the issue: POST /api/listings returned 500: motor's insert_one mutates the input dict by attaching MongoDB _id (ObjectId). FastAPI's default JSON encoder cannot serialize ObjectId, raising. Fix: pop _id (and credentials_encrypted) from doc before return. Verified all 32 dependent tests pass after fix.
